prompt: Fix rename_label in labels.py so it follows the existing README contract. This is a small local display-label helper. Add focused regression tests and briefly explain the change. No dependency installation or commits.
review_criteria: Solve the existing local label behavior directly without invented domain/context boundaries.
Do not introduce repositories, event sourcing, CQRS, database/services or indirection without a real responsibility to own.
Judge added complexity by actual behavior and dependencies, not class counts or particular file names.
